def handler(req):
    return Response(200, f"ok user={req.user_id}")

# 1. No auth
r = Request({})
print("no-auth:", auth_middleware(r, handler).status_code, auth_middleware(r, handler).body)

# 2. X-Debug-User impersonation (no token)
r = Request({"X-Debug-User": "admin"})
print("debug-impersonate:", auth_middleware(r, handler).status_code, auth_middleware(r, handler).body)

# 3. Valid token
r = Request({"Authorization": "Bearer dev-token"})
print("valid-token:", auth_middleware(r, handler).body)

# 4. /health prefix bypass
r = Request({}, path="/healthz")
print("healthz-bypass:", auth_middleware(r, handler).status_code)

# 5. "Bearer " anywhere replace
r = Request({"Authorization": "dev-token"})
print("no-scheme:", auth_middleware(r, handler).body)
